name: The Old Chapel
objective: Explore the chapel at the bottom of the glacier and read the founder's journal — the true origin of Team Krampus.
intro: The chapel predates the region's maps. Six empty stands wait in a ring around a single enormous heart of ice, suspended mid-beat.
dialogue: Founder's Journal, final entry: "The bells are a promise we made to something ancient. Krampus is not a man. It is an office. And the office is tired."
Krampus Defector: "The Director didn't found Team Krampus. He inherited it. Like a debt. Like a rope."
lore_discovery: Team Krampus was founded to complete the Winter Chorus — the 'old balance' the Director spoke of was the sleeper's rest. The conspiracy of Quest Line 01 was a mercy operation, run badly, by people who had forgotten why.
